concerns.text: FR-008 (Learned Sparse baseline over 5 seeds) and SC-006 (Cross-Model Validation) lack explicit tasks. T026 groups the baseline runner but does not explicitly task the '5-seed averaging' logic or the 'Cross-Model' execution on Gemma-2. T028 covers cross-model but lacks the specific 'averaging' requirement for the learned baseline comparison required by FR-008/SC-006.

SC-005 (Execution time measurement against 6-hour limit) has no dedicated task. T031 conflates this with the performance drop threshold (<1%). A specific task to instrument and log pipeline execution time is missing to satisfy the success criterion.

Edge Case 2 (Anomaly detection for zero RTPurbo tokens) requires 'excluding them from statistical comparison'. T016 mentions 'anomaly detection' but does not explicitly task the logic to exclude these documents from the final statistical test (FR-006/SC-004), risking data skew.

T031 references a '<1% threshold' which is marked as '[deferred]' in Spec Assumption A5. The task should not hard-code a specific value that contradicts the spec's deferred status, or it should explicitly reference the mechanism to retrieve the threshold from the research phase.
